2014_spells.prayer-of-healing.descriptio: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range each regain hit points equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
2014_spells.prayer-of-healing.effectSumm: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range each regain hit points equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier
2014_spells.prayer-of-healing.fullDescri: Using 10 minutes, up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range each regain hit points equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
